description: This Java source file defines an immutable class ImmutableAuthorizationSubject implementing the AuthorizationSubject interface, representing a security authorization subject with a unique identifier within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationSubject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of AuthorizationSubject that encapsulates a unique identifier for an authorization subject.
